pages.en: Lily's family has a new house. It has a big garden, a red door and a garage for Dad's car.
pages.zh: Lily 家有了一栋新房子。房子有一个大花园、一扇红门，还有一个停爸爸车子的车库。
pages.scene: A family standing happily in front of a new two-storey house with a red door, a big garden and a garage, moving boxes on the path, Max running on the grass.

pages.en: Downstairs there is a kitchen, a living room and a small bathroom. Upstairs there are three bedrooms.
pages.zh: 楼下有厨房、客厅和一个小卫生间。楼上有三间卧室。
pages.scene: A cosy house cut open like a doll's house: a kitchen and a living room downstairs, three bedrooms upstairs, Lily and Tom running up the stairs.

pages.en: Lily's bedroom is next to Tom's. It has a big window and a bookshelf. "I love my new room!" says Lily. Max loves it too. He sleeps on her bed!
pages.zh: Lily 的卧室在 Tom 的隔壁，有一扇大窗户和一个书架。“我好喜欢我的新房间！”Lily 说。Max 也很喜欢，它睡在 Lily 的床上！
pages.scene: A sunny child's bedroom with a big window and a bookshelf, Lily spinning happily in the middle, Max curled up asleep on her bed.

questions.q: The new house has a garage.

questions.zh: Max 睡在 Tom 的床上。
